<user_query>
Read-only exploration. Locate backend endpoints/controllers/models related to learning records and any existing export endpoints patterns (pdf/excel/image) elsewhere in project. Focus backend/routes/api.php, app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php, auth/role middleware usage, and any controller methods generating files. Return concise bullets with file paths and endpoint signatures relevant for planning teacher-only export of own students with custom date range.
</user_query>

I’ll scan the backend routes and controllers for learning-record and export/file-generation patterns, then summarize endpoint signatures plus role/middleware constraints relevant to a teacher-only date-range export plan.

I found the key route groups and the full learning-record controller. Next I’ll read `ExportController`, relevant models, and auth middleware to extract concrete export/file-response patterns and teacher scoping details.

Relevant backend findings for planning **teacher-only learning-record export (own students + custom date range)**:

- **Learning-record routes + role gates** — `/home/admin/backend/routes/api.php`
  - `GET /api/v1/learning-records` (director+teacher group: `middleware(['role:director,teacher','require_campus','require_password_change'])`)
  - `POST /api/v1/learning-records`
  - `POST|PUT /api/v1/learning-records/{learningRecord}`
  - `DELETE /api/v1/learning-records/{learningRecord}`
  - Director-only learning-record actions (separate `role:director` group):  
    `POST /api/v1/learning-records/{learningRecord}/approve|rollback-approval|request-changes|reject`,  
    `PATCH /api/v1/learning-records/{learningRecord}/teacher`,  
    `POST /api/v1/learning-records/backdoor-approve|bulk-backdoor-approve|batch-approve|reschedule-session|ensure-past`.

- **LearningRecordController teacher scoping behavior** — `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Controllers/LearningRecordController.php`
  - `index(Request)` already enforces teacher scope:
    - if `auth_role === 'teacher'` → `where('TeacherID', auth_teacher_id)` plus `StudentClass.TeacherID == auth_teacher_id` filtering.
  - Supports useful filters already in query params:
    - `status` (single/comma list), `teacher_id`, `student_class_id`, `student_class_ids`, `student_name`, `branch_id|campus_id`, `only_due`, `per_page`.
  - **No date-range filter currently in `index`** (no `start/end` handling), so custom date range for export would need new handling.

- **LearningRecord-related models**  
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Models/LearningRecord.php` (`table = LearningRecord`, relations to `StudentClass`, `ClassSession`, `User`)  
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Models/StudentClass.php` (`table = StudentClass`, PK `ID`)  
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Models/Student.php` (`CampusID` key for branch scoping)  
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Models/ClassSession.php` (`SessionDate`, `StartTime`, `EndTime`)

- **Auth/role middleware wiring**  
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Kernel.php`
    - `'role' => RequireRole`, `'require_campus' => RequireCampus`, API group includes `AttachAuthUser`.
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Middleware/AttachAuthUser.php`
    - sets request attributes: `auth_user`, `auth_role`, `auth_teacher_id`, `auth_campus_ids`, `auth_has_campus`.
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Middleware/RequireRole.php`
    - checks `auth_role`; `super_admin` bypass; otherwise requires one of declared roles.
  - `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Middleware/RequireCampus.php`
    - blocks non-super-admin users with no campus assignment.

- **Existing export endpoint pattern (Excel only)**  
  - Routes in `/home/admin/backend/routes/api.php` (director-only group):
    - `GET /api/v1/students/export`
    - `GET /api/v1/student-classes/export`
    - `GET /api/v1/invoices/export`
  - Controller in `/home/admin/backend/app/Http/Controllers/ExportController.php`:
    - `students()`, `studentClasses()`, `invoices()` each return `Excel::download(...)`.
  - Export classes:
    - `/home/admin/backend/app/Exports/StudentsExport.php`
    - `/home/admin/backend/app/Exports/StudentClassesExport.php`
    - `/home/admin/backend/app/Exports/InvoicesExport.php`
    - all use `FromCollection` with `Model::all(...)` (no requester/date/teacher scoping).

- **PDF/image/file-generation scan result (backend controllers)**  
  - Searched controllers for `PDF/dompdf/streamDownload/response()->download/image` patterns.
  - **Found only Excel file generation via `Maatwebsite\Excel\Facades\Excel::download`** in `ExportController`.
  - No existing backend PDF/image generation endpoints found.
